tldr: Anthropic cut Fable/Mythos 5.1 cache prices 75% in early September after Zhipu's GLM-5.3-Flash undercut. On Sep 22 Opus 5.5 and OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna shipped within an hour of each other, and 40-50% price cuts spread across labs.
whats_new: Claude Sonnet 5.5 reached Amazon Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS on Sep 28, pitched at a lower cost per task and faster speed than earlier Sonnet models.
why_it_matters: Anthropic is now selling on cost per task, not list price, and Sonnet 5.5 extends that to the cheaper tier on AWS. Re-benchmark cost per task, not per token.

status.detail: Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol/Luna's same-day launch escalated into 40-50% price cuts; Anthropic then published cost-per-task guidance, and on Sep 28 Sonnet 5.5 arrived on AWS.

beats.headline: Anthropic ships Claude Opus 5.5; OpenAI answers within the hour with GPT-6 Sol and Luna
beats.summary: Same-day flagship releases from both labs, framed as a new price war rather than a one-off launch.

beats.headline: Everybody cuts prices 40-50% in Opus 5.5's wake
Opus 5.5 lands on AWS Bedrock, then gets its own cost-and-context guidance
beats.summary: Anthropic published why longer, context-heavy coding sessions shaped Opus 5.5's design, then what a Claude Code task actually costs on it and which settings move the bill.

beats.headline: Sonnet 5.5 lands on AWS as the lower-cost-per-task option
beats.summary: AWS positions Sonnet 5.5 for focused coding and knowledge work at faster speed.

open_questions: Do Claude Opus 5.5's and GPT-6 Sol/Luna's posted prices actually beat GLM-5.3-Flash's domestic-chip pricing, or just each other?
Which labs specifically matched the 40-50% cut, and does actual per-task cost (per AWS's guidance) net out cheaper despite Opus 5.5's higher list price?
Does Sonnet 5.5's cost per task on Claude Code undercut Opus 5.5 by enough to change default model choice?
take_for_builders: Re-run your Claude vs. GPT cost model per task, including Sonnet 5.5 on Bedrock, and pin the model version behind each eval.
